stories.title: Validate Bilingual Semantic Equivalence Across All 20 CoCu Files
stories.description: Implement automated validation that English and Bahasa Malaysia sections maintain semantic equivalence using sentence-transformers embeddings. Ensures translated content doesn't lose technical accuracy or pedagogical value.
acceptanceCriteria: Script validates each section in content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md using sentence-transformers with 0.85+ cosine similarity threshold for EN/BM pairs
Generates HTML report in output/bilingual_equivalence_report.html listing all section pairs with similarity scores and flags low-confidence translations
CLI command: uv run scripts/validate_bilingual_equivalence.py content/ output/ returns exit code 0 if all matches ≥0.85, exit code 1 if failures detected

stories.title: Generate Instructor Facilitation Guides with 50-Minute Session Plans per CoCu
stories.description: Create comprehensive instructor guides (.docx) for each of 20 CoCu files with structured 50-minute lesson plans, timing guides, assessment strategies, and activity sequencing aligned to Bloom's 2023 taxonomy.
acceptanceCriteria: Generates output/Instructor_Guides_IT020_L{3,4,5}.docx with 50-min session plans for each CoCu (Opening 5min, Core Activity 35min, Assessment 10min structure)
Each plan includes learning outcomes alignment, required materials list, facilitation tips, student grouping suggestions, and Bloom's cognitive level mapping per activity
CLI command: uv run scripts/generate_instructor_guides.py content/ output/ creates guides using same formatting as generate_docx.py (NOSS-compliant tables, headers, footers)

stories.title: Implement Flesch-Kincaid Cognitive Load Analysis for All Content
stories.description: Analyze readability and cognitive load across all 20 CoCu files using Flesch-Kincaid grade level scoring and passive voice detection. Generate actionable remediation suggestions to improve accessibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Script analyzes content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md sections, calculates Flesch-Kincaid grade level per section (target: 8-10 for L3, 9-11 for L4/L5)
Detects passive voice constructions (target: <20% of sentences) and identifies sentences >25 words (cognitive overload risk)
Generates JSON report (output/cognitive_load_analysis.json) with section-by-section scores, flags for remediation, and sample rewrites using active voice

stories.title: Validate Bloom's Taxonomy 2023 Action Verb Distribution in Learning Outcomes
stories.description: Automatically extract and categorize action verbs from all learning outcomes across 20 CoCu files against Bloom's 2023 revised taxonomy. Verify cognitive level distribution aligns with pedagogical standards.
acceptanceCriteria: Script parses learning outcome matrices from content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md, extracts action verbs using regex pattern matching against Bloom's 2023 verb lists
Maps verbs to Bloom's 2023 levels (Remember/Understand/Apply/Analyze/Evaluate/Create) and validates distribution: 10% Rem, 20% Und, 30% App, 25% Ana, 15% Eva+Cre
Generates JSON report (output/blooms_taxonomy_validation.json) with current distribution percentages, flags outcomes outside ±5% tolerance, and suggests replacement verbs

stories.title: Create Interactive Student Mastery Competency Dashboard (HTML + SVG)
stories.description: Generate interactive HTML dashboard showing student progress toward competency mastery. Color-coded heatmap visualizes achievement against all learning outcomes across all 20 CoCu files.
acceptanceCriteria: Generates output/student_mastery_dashboard.html with JavaScript-powered interactive heatmap (red <50%, yellow 50-79%, green 80%+) displaying all learning outcomes as rows, CoCu files as columns
Dashboard loads from output/mastery_data.json with student competency scores, filterable by level (L3/L4/L5) and CoCu unit
CLI command: uv run scripts/generate_mastery_dashboard.py content/ output/ also exports dashboard as SVG (output/mastery_dashboard.svg) for print-friendly reports

stories.title: Generate Malaysian Workplace Scenarios Aligned to SIRIM/BNM/ISCO-08 Standards
stories.description: Create realistic workplace scenario exercises embedded in practical worksheets referencing Malaysian industry standards (SIRIM, BNM, ISCO-08 occupational codes). Enhance practical relevance and local context.
acceptanceCriteria: Script generates 3-5 workplace scenarios per CoCu (60 total) with each scenario file including metadata: SIRIM standard reference, BNM/ISCO-08 occupational codes, required competencies
Scenarios integrated into content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md practical exercise sections with context-based learning activities and success criteria

CLI command: uv run scripts/generate_workplace_scenarios.py content/ output/ produces output/workplace_scenarios_mapping.csv with scenario ID, title, standards referenced, and linked learning outcome IDs

stories.title: Implement Automated JPK Compliance Validation with 25+ Audit Rules
stories.description: Build comprehensive automated compliance checker validating NOSS/JPK standards across all 20 CoCu files. Includes header format verification, contact hour mathematics, assessment structure validation, and more.
acceptanceCriteria: Implements 25+ validation rules: NOSS header format (program code/level/unit present), contact hour math (L3=1200, correct % distribution), 30% Knowledge/70% Performance split verified, assessment sections present, all learning outcomes mapped to exercises, bilingual header tables complete

CLI command: uv run scripts/validate_jpk_compliance.py content/ generates output/jpk_compliance_audit.json with pass/fail status per rule per CoCu, severity level (critical/warning/info), and remediation guidance
Returns exit code 0 if all critical rules pass, exit code 1 if any critical failures; output integrable with CI/CD pipelines (supports JSON, CSV export formats)

stories.title: Detect and Report Semantic Duplication Across CoCu Content
stories.description: Identify duplicate or near-duplicate content sections within and across CoCu files using sentence-transformers embeddings. Generate detailed reports to improve content uniqueness and reduce redundancy.
acceptanceCriteria: Script uses sentence-transformers to embed all sections from content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md, compares all pairs with cosine similarity ≥0.85 threshold

Generates JSON report (output/semantic_duplication_report.json) listing duplicate pairs with file paths, similarity scores (0.85-1.0 range), excerpt previews (first 100 chars), and suggested consolidation
CLI command: uv run scripts/detect_semantic_duplication.py content/ output/ --threshold 0.85 with optional verbosity flag for debugging

stories.title: Generate Competency Prerequisite DAG and Detect Circular Dependencies
stories.description: Parse learning outcomes across all CoCu files to construct a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of competency prerequisites. Detect cycles and identify missing prerequisite chains.
acceptanceCriteria: Script extracts learning outcomes from content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md, builds prerequisite DAG based on explicit 'requires' metadata and outcome text dependency analysis using NLP
Detects circular dependencies using depth-first search cycle detection algorithm, flags orphaned competencies (zero prerequisites AND zero dependents), and identifies missing prerequisite chains
Generates Mermaid diagram (output/competency_prerequisite_dag.md) suitable for documentation and JSON graph structure (output/competency_dag.json) with node IDs, edges, and metadata

stories.title: Validate Bilingual Glossary Consistency and Generate Unified Glossary Appendix
stories.description: Ensure consistent terminology usage across English and Bahasa Malaysia content. Extract, validate, and generate a unified bilingual glossary appendix for all 20 CoCu files.
acceptanceCriteria: Script extracts key terms from content/IT-020-{3,4,5}/*.md using regex patterns on marked glossary sections, validates EN/BM term pairs for consistency across all files, flags duplicate definitions or contradictory translations
Generates output/unified_bilingual_glossary.xlsx with columns: EN term, BM translation, definition, CoCu references (file:section), consistency flag (pass/fail), suggested correction

CLI command: uv run scripts/validate_bilingual_glossary.py content/ output/ returns exit code 0 if 100% consistent, exit code 1 if discrepancies; also generates output/glossary_appendix.docx formatted for inclusion in generate_docx.py output
